expectations.text: Uses aws ce get-cost-and-usage CLI command or equivalent
expectations.evidence: Uses 'aws ce get-cost-and-usage' with BlendedCost metric and SERVICE grouping
Groups by Type=DIMENSION,Key=SERVICE with expected JSON output format
Multiple references: 'Compare to budget alert — Your CloudFormation template has a $50/month budget alert'

expectations.text: Identifies Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway as key services
expectations.evidence: Lists all 6 Lambda functions with individual cost estimates, DynamoDB on-demand pricing, API Gateway REST v1 costs

expectations.text: Mentions third-party API costs (Anthropic, Google Places) beyond just AWS
expectations.evidence: Explicitly covers: 'Anthropic (Claude API): Varies wildly. If AI function is called 100 times/day with Haiku model: ~$60/month' and 'Google Places: One-time seeder cost ~$5.76'
